feed.title: Zombie Facts
feed.subtitle: Retracted, debunked and outdated facts still in circulation, and the fixes.

entry.title: Note posted: Non-coding RNA
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “Non-coding RNA” cites a retracted paper. Cancer Management and Research retracted this paper in 2021 over duplicated images. Other citations on the sentence still support it.

entry.title: Editors replied: Gary Null
entry.summary: Slatersteven wrote: “We don't need it, as there are other sources. Slatersteven (”

entry.title: Note posted: Douz
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “Douz” cites a retracted paper. The American Journal of Biological Anthropology retracted this study in March 2026 over a lack of ethics approval.

entry.title: Note posted: Gary Null
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “Gary Null” cites a retracted paper. This version of the Cochrane review on therapeutic touch was withdrawn over concerns about the underlying data.

entry.title: Note posted: Maus
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “Maus” cites a retracted paper. Shofar retracted this essay for plagiarism. It is listed in the article's list of scholarship on Maus.

entry.title: Note posted: North Koreans in Russia
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “North Koreans in Russia” cites a retracted paper. Cold War History retracted this article in 2020 for plagiarism.

entry.title: Note posted: 2010 in science
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “2010 in science” cites a retracted paper. Science retracted the arsenic-life paper in July 2025 because its results could not be reproduced. The 2010 entry can stay as history, but it still reads as an established discovery.

entry.title: Note posted: 2011 in science
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “2011 in science” cites a retracted paper. The Lancet retracted the SCIPIO trial report in 2019 after Harvard's investigation found unreliable data. The 2011 entry still presents it as a breakthrough.

entry.title: Note posted: 2011 in science
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “2011 in science” cites a retracted paper. Cell retracted this paper in 2014. The 2011 entry still presents skin-to-neuron conversion from this paper as a result.

entry.title: Note posted: List of pseudoscience topics
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “List of pseudoscience topics” cites a retracted paper. The sentence quotes the review's conclusion directly, and the review was withdrawn by Cochrane over concerns about the data it relied on, so the quote no longer has a valid source.

entry.title: Note posted: Axon
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “Axon” cites a retracted paper. Cell retracted this paper in 2023 after an investigation found manipulated images.

entry.title: Note posted: Stegodyphus dumicola
entry.summary: We told Wikipedia's editors that “Stegodyphus dumicola” cites a retracted paper. Animal Behaviour retracted this paper in 2023 over duplicated data; it is one of the Jonathan Pruitt papers withdrawn during the misconduct investigation into his lab.
